# Appendix C: Matplotlib Property Reference

A visual and property quick-guide for styling scientific plots in Matplotlib.

## 1. Line Styles (`linestyle` or `ls`)

| Specifier | Name | Visual Appearance |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `'-'` or `'solid'` | Solid line | `──────────────` |
| `'--'` or `'dashed'` | Dashed line | `─── ─── ─── ───` |
| `':'` or `'dotted'` | Dotted line | `· · · · · · · ·` |
| `'-.'` or `'dashdot'`| Dash-dot line | `─── · ─── · ───` |
| `'none'` or `''` | No line (scatter only) | |

## 2. Marker Styles (`marker`)

| Specifier | Marker Symbol | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `'o'` | $\bullet$ | Circle |
| `'s'` | $\blacksquare$ | Square |
| `'^'` | $\blacktriangle$ | Triangle Up |
| `'v'` | $\blacktriangledown$ | Triangle Down |
| `'d'` or `'D'` | $\blacklozenge$ | Diamond |
| `'*'` | $\star$ | Star |
| `'+'` | $+$ | Plus sign |
| `'x'` | $\times$ | Cross |
| `'.'` | $\cdot$ | Point |

## 3. Common Color Codes (`color` or `c`)

| Code | Color Name | Hex Code Equivalent |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `'b'` | Blue | `#0000FF` |
| `'g'` | Green | `#008000` |
| `'r'` | Red | `#FF0000` |
| `'c'` | Cyan | `#00BFBF` |
| `'m'` | Magenta | `#BF00BF` |
| `'y'` | Yellow | `#BFBF00` |
| `'k'` | Black | `#000000` |
| `'w'` | White | `#FFFFFF` |
| `'orange'` | Scientific Orange | `#FF7F0E` |
| `'teal'` | Teal | `#008080` |

## 4. Key Plot Method Arguments

```python
plt.plot(x, y,
         color='darkblue',       # Color of line
         linestyle='--',         # Dash pattern
         linewidth=2.0,          # Thickness of line in points
         marker='o',             # Shape of points
         markersize=6,           # Point diameter
         markerfacecolor='red',  # Fill color inside marker
         markeredgecolor='black',# Border outline of marker
         alpha=0.8,              # Transparency: 0.0 (clear) to 1.0 (opaque)
         label='Run 1')          # Legend text
```
